about_the_game:
Cuber is a low-poly endless runner game in which you have to keep an ice cube alive.

There are many obstacles, as well as items that influence the effect of the obstacles. So you have to make smart decisions: do you avoid obstacles, or do you try to get rid of them with the help of the items? Your goal is to stay alive as long as possible and score as many points and cover as much distance as you can.

  • Endless Running - Play as long as you can keep it up

  • Stay Cool - You are constantly melting, collect ice to keep cool

  • Destroy Obstacles - Get more points for destroying obstacles like barricades, fire, UFO and many more

  • Simple controls – The controls are very simple and consist only of the Left, Right and Jump. Both Keyboard and Controller are supported.
